text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The Anunnaki he caused to take their seats.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: In the Assembly Hall, place where the great judgments are decided,

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Decisions to arrange he caused them to know.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: These gods he caused to take up there their abode.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Their clean sacrificial food he gave, their crowns he clothed upon them.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: In the king’s place, the throne room, the _ḳinsig_ of the vast abode,

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The libation of wine and honey yearly he decreed.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: For Nippur the city whose shadow extends afar

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The people, the dark headed, he caused to have reverence.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: But its habitations he cursed ...

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Like scattered cows he scattered them.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The city’s interior is filled with weeping,

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
sumerian: en-na dam dingir ga-ša-an-bi li-bi nu-tar-ri
translation: While the consort, its divine queen, is not solicitous for her.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The great house which knew the cry of multitudes,

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Like a vast building in ruins men enter not.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: In Nippur, the city where great princes were prosperous,

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Why have they fled?

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The people, the dark headed, all of them like sheep....

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
sumerian: e(?)-en-šú KAK-RU er a-nir šag PA-ḪI-BAD-a
translation: How long shall loud crying(?), weeping and wailing _distress_ (?) the heart?

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: How long shall the soul be terrified?

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: And the heart repose not?

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: To the drum and cymbals I sing.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: ... sorrowfully(?)....

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: ... _brick_ ... they dwell.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: ... in tears they speak.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: ... are made small.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: ... in misery they speak.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: ... whose habitations are desolated.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Unto ... they have hastened.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: ... like one that knows not.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: ... is in confusion.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: ... evil they know not, good they have decreed.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Bitter lament I utter.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Her population like cattle of the fields within her have perished.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Helas! my Land! I sigh.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
sumerian: ki-el kalag tul-tul-lá-bi-ne sùr-ri- -eš mi-ni-ib- sal-la-áš
translation: Maid and young man and their children cruelly have been scattered far and wide.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Tearfully I sigh.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Their brothers like a rain storm have fled afar.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: I cease not to weep.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
sumerian: é-e áb amar-bi kud-du gim ní-bi-šù ūr-gíg-ga im-gub
translation: The household like a cow, whose calf has been separated from her, stand by themselves with sorrowful souls.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: They have lapsed into the misery of silence.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Oh sing to the lyre! The wailers like a child nursing mother who cries in woe

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: because of them devised lamentation.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The city whose lord had been magnified,

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
sumerian: igi-ni sá kûr-ra ib-ta-an-gar-ra ad-e-eš ba-an-ara-áš
translation: In whose presence a hostile rule has been established, with sighing they have caused to walk.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: As for the faithful temple, which in the lands excelled all,

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: (Where) the people, the dark headed, reposed _in security_;

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: What has done it, what has destroyed it?

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Its lord is a fugitive, he _hastens in flight_.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: A melody with prostrations. Second section.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The meaning of the great decrees they have glorified. Sorrowful words they restrain not.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: This is its antiphon.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The city whose lord is distressed,

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
sumerian: en-šú la-ba-ši-gur-ru suģ-ám-bi nu- um- im me
translation: Until when shall it not return (to its rest)? Until when shall its “How long” not be spoken?

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Why are its brick walls trodden underfoot?

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
sumerian: tu(ģu) za-pa-ág mà-mà-bi ab-ta ib-ta- an-dal
translation: The doves screaming flew from their nests.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The temple ... the sweet voiced flute,

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The temple violently....

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The temple like one without reverence....

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Its regulations unholy ones....

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Its cult of ablutions like those which had not been chosen above those of all lands

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: He has demolished, its wealth he seized away.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: In misery of soul how long shall I utter lament?

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Why after the destruction has been done is it not respected?

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: As one who accomplishes pure things this one has uttered a curse:—

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: “Why rise her brick-walls in effulgent glory?”

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Night and day within her wailing is made.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Now the stranger has wrought insult.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Its lord like a storm wind _their hands have removed_(?)

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Their city, their temple, he has destroyed.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Its foundation he laid waste, the skilled workmen he transported.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Wife and children within her he slew.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Their city a subjected city he caused to become.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Its property he himself took as plunder.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Their city which was he has caused to become a city which is not.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Its works of art he placed a hostile foot upon.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Its garments he seized away, the winds tore them in shreds.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Its food and drink he pilfered.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Their infants(?) ... he caused to perish.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The temple a stranger plundered.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Bitter sighing I utter, tears I pour out.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Oh sing to the lyre, he that speaks the songs of wailing.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Their hearts which are not glad it will pacify.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The decrees of their lord they have glorified.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: He concerns himself not with their oracles; he cares not for their future.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: A melody with prostrations. Third section.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: His great decrees thus he has ordered.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: He has concerned himself not with their oracles; he cared not for their future.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: This is its antiphon.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: He of melodious song the sorrowful fate weeps for.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Sound of mourning he causes to arise; lamentation he utters.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Now oh sing to the lyre! They that know the melodies

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: My ... shall speak for me.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Now I am filled with sighing.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Her population offer prayers to me.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Now my intercession, my pleading(?),

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Now mightily the population unite with me in making known.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Upon ways of pain my mercy

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Oh woe! my children weep for.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: In the house, the well builded temple, in their dwelling,

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Sound like one chanting is raised and praise is diminished.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The foe has caused my land to perish.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: They beseech....

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
sumerian: šag ág-gíg-ga ib-sȋg-mu ad-bi-šú PI-gà-bi dé-ib-šed-dé-ne-ám
translation: My heart which is filled with misery by their wailing ... may they calm.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Their weeping is made unto me.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: In the mother goddess’ sanctuary prayer to me they offer.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Enlil....

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Have mercy upon me.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Thy heart whose portion has been affliction become for me a glad heart.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Thy head which is held aloof turn unto me to glorify thy portion.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The hostile deeds which he did unto thee be returned unto his hand.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: In the city which knew not forgiveness let there be given _the cry of multitudes_.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: A melody of prostrations. Fifth section.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Now thy lord _anger upon the foe_ will direct.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: He will have mercy and will decree thy fate.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Unto thy brick walls where lamentation arose he will command “it is enough.”

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Thy happy soul he will cause to return for me.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Ninurash the valiant guardsman will sustain thy head.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: His pastor he will establish over (the city).

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Ekur like (a temple) which has been tenderly built he will make....

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Its beauty he will restore to its place.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: Unceasingly he commands.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The ordinances the stranger has placed in confusion.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The ritual utensils which have been scattered he will restore to their place.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The rituals of hand-washing which the wicked caused to lapse into disuse,

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: To cause to be holy and pure

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: In the holy city which has been consecrated he commands.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: For Ishme-Dagan his beloved shepherd

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: ... to cause rejoicing

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: ... he commands.

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
translation: The holy ... whose fate has been decreed,

text_title: LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LAMENTATION OF ISHME-DAGAN OVER NIPPUR
LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: Enlil king of the gods

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: In the South and North may give lordship over them unto me.

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: By the commands of Nunamnir,

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: By the utterance of Enlil,

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: May Anu speak for me an order of confidence.

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: Scepters may he give unto my hand.

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: May Uraša bestow upon me faithful care in his holy throne room.

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: Ninlil whose heart is pure,

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: She that in the far-famed chapel _assures_ length of days,

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: She that renders good my portion exceedingly,

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: She who unto Enlil spoke assuringly for me good words,

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: She who daily protects Ekur for me,

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: May render me my fate in Kenur the vast place.

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: May Enki the great lord of Eridu

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: Sustain(?) my head in the ritual chamber, the faithful, the far-famed.

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: Of the great Kenur its care....

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: Of Enlil his oracle be proclaimed.

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: Unto the words of father Enlil—

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: Ishme-Dagan am I—verily my neck I will turn.

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: To the utterance of my king may I lend my ears.

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: In Sumer justice may I institute.

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: Nippur may I exalt like heaven.

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: Of Ekur its decrees I will deliver.

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: Of the plans(?) unto their care may I give heed.

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: The sacred relics which have fallen from their places may I restore to their places.

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: Of Enlil his precious decrees—

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: I am Ishme-Dagan—I will....

text_title: LITURGY OF ISHME-DAGAN
translation: Of Ninlil her ... I will....

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Oh lady of the good decrees, that risest splendidly like the sun.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Faithful woman, bearing a sheen  of terrible splendor, beloved of Urashâ,

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Heavenly virgin, queen(?) of the great songs,

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Who _puttest on_ a faithful crown, who hast been created fit for rulership,

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Whose hand attaineth the seven decrees,

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: My queen, of the great decrees their directress art thou.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: The decrees thou bearest; the decrees thou holdest in thy hand.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: The decrees thou directest; the decrees thou claspest to thy breast(?)

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Like a champion thou subduest the foreign lands.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Like the storm-god in the place of the ... curse the grain-goddess thou leavest not.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: A whirlwind upon their lands thou sendest.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Oh leader of heaven and earth their divinity thou art.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: For them thou didst create the Land (of Sumer).

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: That givest orders unto the gods(?), queen that guidest the universe.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: That utterest command by the holy order of Anu.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
sumerian: garza-gal-gal-la gar zu a-ba mu- ... un- ... zu
translation: The great decisions who (but thee) knoweth to teach?

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Thou that shatterest the mountains, by a spirit of wrath thou art filled.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Beloved of Enlil, thou hast founded the Land.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Thou art she that hast effected the mandate of Ninlil.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: My lady, at thy cry the lands quake.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: At the fear of thy splendor let mankind

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: With shouting await thee.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Fittingly they have received their terrible decrees from thee.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Thy lamentations and mournings let them wail for thee.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Unto the temple the chief singers shall walk the streets for thee(??).

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: From before the face of battle they hasten unto thee.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: My lady, of thy _fury_ they speak.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: The spirit like an onrushing storm rushed over them.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: The spirit with a loud cry annihilated the people.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: By the storm god they were ... accursed.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: By the storm winds they were brought to woe.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Thy foot hastens restless in the street.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Upon the lyre of weeping they utter lamentation.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Oh my lady, the Anunnaki, the great gods,

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Like a flying _sudin_-bird from the crannies hasten unto thee.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: When before thy feet they run,

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Unto the presence of thy feet they attain not.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Thine angry heart who shall pacify?

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Thine evilly disposed heart let become calm.

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Oh lady, whose soul is magnanimous; oh lady [whose ... is ... ]

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Whose wrath is unpacified....

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Lady that stormeth over the mountains....

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: The mountains (?) thy place (?)....

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: The great gate....

text_title: LITURGICAL HYMN TO INNINI
translation: Its frost....

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: May Enlil graciously eat; yea graciously eat.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Where Anu sits may the people hasten.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: [_The Anunnaki._] Where Anu sits let the people hasten.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: To the temple he enters, the mighty priest of sacrifices to the temple enters.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: A libation he offers, the priest of hand washing a libation offers.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: To the temple at mid-day go up! at sun-set go up.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Daily to direct the sacrifices go up!

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Daily to direct the prayers go up!

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
sumerian: ud-da an dìm-me-ir mu-zu an-ni zu-zu-dam
translation: Daily Anu merciful god on high _proclaim_.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The hero of heaven and earth, hero of the sacred city on high _proclaim_.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: To Enlil let all the land, to Enlil let all the people hasten.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
sumerian: an-ni a-ma-an-tú an-gù(?) an-ni a-ma-an-tú šă-ab ám-ma-ab-túg-e
translation: Unto heaven verily I will libate water, unto the _canopy_ of heaven, unto heaven verily I will libate water. The heart I will appease.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: I will pour out a libation, the father I will appease.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The hero of heaven and earth, the hero of the sacred city I will appease.

translation: He has been pacified [    ]

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: He has been pacified [    ]

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: He has been pacified, the heart of ... [has been pacified]

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: He has been pacified, the great mountain [Enlil has been pacified]

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: In the ... plain of Eridu....

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: A tempest it is shattering the mountain.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The word of the lord is a tempest.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The heart of the exalted is a tempest.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The heart of Enlil is a tempest.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
sumerian: ù-mu-un-na šag an-šú an ní-ne ba-ni-ib-gam-ma-[ne]
translation: The heart of the lord is in heaven and the heavens waver of themselves.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
sumerian: d.mu-ul-lil e-ne-em ki-šú ki ní sīg-ga-ni
translation: The word of Enlil is on earth and the earth trembles of itself.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The word which brings woe to the spirits of earth.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
sumerian: e-ne-em-mà-ni a-zu nu-tuk šim-šar nu-[un-    tuk]
translation: His word a prophet has not; a magician it has not.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: His word is an onrushing tempest, an adversary to oppose it has not.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The faithful messenger, he called by a good name.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The god who satiates with milk and grain, _sag_....

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Heaven and earth it has pacified.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Earth and heaven it pacified.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: When in Ekur the great mountain Enlil it pacified,

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: [When] in Elamma the great mother Ninlil it pacified,

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: In Annigarra the _consort (sister)_ of Enlil it pacified.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The exalted who walketh forth, where tarries he?

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Who walketh forth, the exalted who walketh forth, where tarries he?

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The lord of the lands, who walketh forth, where tarries he?

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The lord of faithful word, who etc.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Enlil, father of the Land, who etc.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Shepherd of the dark-headed people, who etc.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: He of self-created vision, who etc.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Hero that directs his hosts, who etc.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: He that sleeps the sleep of perversity, who etc.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: I in a great bowl will pour out wine to him.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: I like a wild ox will bow down to the mighty one.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: “Thy city is destroyed,” will I say to him.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: “Kenur and Enamtila are destroyed,” will I say to him.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: “In Sippar Ebarra is destroyed,” etc.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: “Thy city Babylon is destroyed,” etc.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: “Esagila and Barsippa are destroyed,” etc.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: “Ezida and Emahtila are destroyed,” etc.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: “Etemenanki is destroyed,” etc.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: “Edaranna is destroyed,” etc.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: “Wailing on the reed-flute ascends in her,” will I say to him.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: When I am overjoyous in his presence may I not stand.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: As to Enlil when I am overjoyous in his presence may I not stand.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: In the presence of Enlil may I not stand; may he behold me not.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: I am a stranger and a fugitive.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
sumerian: a è-ne al-dib a è-ne al-dib
translation: The risen waters seized away; the risen waters seized away.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Queen of city and house, great mother Ninlil am I.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Aruru, sister of Enlil I am.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: A _queenly_ caretaker, queen of Nippur I am.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: An holy queen, queen of the convent I am.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: In the builded house, in the builded house,

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Enlil [_lord_] of lands in the builded house,

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: My consort dwells not in the builded house.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
sumerian: At the end of this column began a long titular melody.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Enlil and his consort Ninlil (we will pacify). (= Tab. Vir. Rev. 12.)

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Anu-Uraš _kisegunu_.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Enki and Ninki, Enul and Ninul.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Endašurimma, Nindašurimma.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The Lord of Duazag, the Queen of Duazag.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Mother Ninlil and father Enlil.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Enuttilla and Enmenšarra.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Ninzianna and Ninharsag.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Šulpae, lord of the sacrificial board.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Mother Šentur, (mother) of the seven gods.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The lord _light_ of Nippur, mighty lord.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The loud crying, queen of Nippur.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Divine first born daughter, divine queen of treasures.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Nusku of mighty message, divine spirit of Ekur.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The son, [great messenger, Nannar-Sin.]

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Zir [spouse of Nannar].

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: [The august] prefect, [divine Enlilzi]

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: [Enbul son of Ešabba.]

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Hero of [heaven, lord of the great mountain.]

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Ningal [heavenly mother.]

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The queen of heaven [who alone is strong.]

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Her husband [Tammuz.]

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The mother of the lord, Ninsun.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Lugalbanda lord of Ešnunak.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The heavenly sister-in-law, Geštinanna.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Enanun mother of loud weeping.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Ninda-Gud, the radiant son.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Šunirda, queen, heroine of battle.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The pious daughter, Ninkar-nunna.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Queen(?) of the dead, Lumma the heroic.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Lord of the grave, lord of the seizing hand.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Great Girra, hero unopposable.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The good genius of the dark ways of the plain.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Ninsig Guškinbanda,

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Lord of whatsoever is, the sculptured form.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The earth woman, beneficent Bau.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
sumerian: ù-mu-un né me en ga-ša-an abzu
translation: Lord of might, lord of decrees, priest of the deep.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Ašnan the divine cleanser, the ... loud crying.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Lord of light, director of the earth, and the daughter of the prince.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The demon of my city the dog of seven heads.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Gibil ... warlike man.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Uttaedde lord of the holy place.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: [Lord of the land, light of heaven.]

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: [Lord Nergal, him of the seizing hand.]

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: [Allat and Ningišzida]

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: [Irriš, the heroic] lord of the soil.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: [The divine mother of the temple of the chief city queen who gives life to the dead.]

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The lofty browed queen of Isin.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Pabil-sag lord of Larak.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Gunura bar of the Land.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: The pious Damu lord of the flood.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Immer lord of terror.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: ... the river.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Lord of the souls of Sumer, of the souls of the lands.

text_title: A LITURGY TO ENLIL, SERIES _E-LUM GUD-SUN_ (ZIMMERN KL
translation: Suddam, daughter of the prince, mother of Ešabba.
